result.title: BusemannFormer: Horospherical Self-Attention for Hyperbolic Graph Transformers
result.summary: Hyperbolic neural networks excel on hierarchical graph data, yet existing hyperbolic Transformers largely adapt conventional attention without explicitly exploiting the ideal boundary, a geometric structure closely tied to tree hierarchy. We propose Horospherical Self-Attention (HSA): each query selects an ideal-boundary direction and scores keys by their Busemann depth along that direction, yielding a token-to-token hyperbolic attention kernel. We establish a flat-limit connection to dot-product attention, characterize score level sets as horospheres, and bound key-side gradients. HSA is integrated into BusemannFormer, a fully hyperbolic graph Transformer, with a log-depth variant that uses query depth to modulate attention concentration. We further introduce a finite-boundary-dictionary extension supporting linear-complexity global attention. Experiments on hierarchical and citation graphs show that BusemannFormer-LD outperforms the evaluated baselines on several node-classification benchmarks and achieves competitive performance across diverse graph structures.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Horospherical Self-Attention：每个 query 在双曲空间的理想边界上选一个方向，用 Busemann 深度为 key 打分，构成 token 间双曲注意力核，并集成到全双曲图 Transformer BusemannFormer 中，附带用 query 深度调节注意力集中度的 log-depth 变体与线性复杂度边界字典扩展，在层级图与引文图节点分类上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其双曲注意力核与按 query 深度调节注意力集中度的机制，可能为 LVR 中层级化 latent 状态几何与动态计算分配提供线索，但论文本身面向图节点分类、不涉及多模态推理，可迁移性需核查。
